channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Shark Bites
channel.desc: Steve Backshall reveals the supersucker of all sharks, the nurse shark. This shark has a taste for shellfish and armoured crustaceans. In Mexico, Steve finds one resting amongst the coral and explains how the nurse shark uses specialist sensory barbells to detect its prey in the sand or crevices. However, to understand how it actually eats its prey, we join Steve in his shark lab.

channel.title: Horrible Histories
channel.desc: Savage Songs compilation. Featuring the hip-hop battle of the boasting Celts, pop superstar Cleopatra, rock rebel William Wallace, the soulful Suffragettes, the funky Aztec priests, the crooning caveman, bad boy heartthrob Dick Turpin, pouting Richard III, the children of the Victorian workhouses, and the many, many merry monarchs.

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Deadly 60
channel.desc: Steve is on his home turf, scouring land, sea and air for some of the deadliest critters that the UK has to offer. First, he heads for the seas off the coast of Plymouth in search of monsters from the deep. And he's not disappointed! In the bowels of a wreck he comes face to face with a giant conger eel, one of the most feared predators in the ocean. Back on land he meets a double deadly killer, the dragonfly. As adults they are amazing aerial assassins, but they lead a double life. Before they emerge as elegant winged beauties, the larvae are terrors of the underwater world, impaling their unsuspecting prey with their alien-like double-hinged jaws. Finally, with the aid of a giant vertical wind tunnel, Steve tries to hover like a kestrel, one of the prettiest but fiercest falcons.

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Operation Ouch!
channel.desc: Identical twin doctors Dr Chris and Dr Xand van Tulleken show how incredible the human body is. With big stunts and exciting experiments, the doctors explore the extraordinary ways our bodies work and show how medicine can fix us when things go wrong. And in a new mind-bending strand, the medical twins test out psychological tricks on an unsuspecting public. Dr Chris and Dr Xand reveal the surprising secret behind the speed of your nerves, Dr Xand finds out what happens if you don't wash your hands, and the twins head out onto the street to test out a mind-bending trick that reveals how you can make your favourite cake look bigger than it is. Meanwhile, the ouch-mobile is opening its doors for more medical mysteries, and in accident and emergency one patient has a sweet stuck up their nose and another has an ear that is swelling fast.

channel.name: CBBC UK

Who will be triumphant as the brothers put Aaron to the test with more wildlife wonders? channel.title: Reflections With Fr. Leo Clifford

channel.title: Saint Margaret Clitherow: The Marriage Of The Lamb

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Grab Your Catechism With Fr. Connor

channel.title: Les Sept Sacrements De L'eglise

channel.title: Daily Mass

channel.title: Father Spitzer?s Universe

channel.title: new! Ewtn News Nightly

channel.title: Islande, ? Travers De Desert Glace

(30 minutes).

channel.title: Living Divine Mercy

channel.title: Psalms In The Life Of David

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in an apartment above the shops. Peggi and Pandora Panda, and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Peppa and family come to help make a garden on the roof of the apartments. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the apartment. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Peppa and all her friends are having a sleepover - different friends in each of the apartments in the high street. So they play hide and seek across all the rooms.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: The children must walk to school in a walking bus! Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own endings too.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson, helped by Mummy Rhino on the piano. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Today is the grown-ups' singing competition at the theatre and the kids are the judges. The children jump up and down and sing along. Everybody loves singing.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Today, Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Larenzo Lion who lives there! Larenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard! The children all believe it's a dinosaur.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
channel.desc: Miss Cookie's class is out on a nature trail, in the Little Kingdom! It is up to Ben and Holly to prevent the elves and fairies being discovered.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
channel.desc: Ben and Holly set out to rescue Redbeard the Elf Pirate's sunken treasure. Mr Elf steers the Elf Submarine to the bottom of the lake, but then they are gobbled up by Big Bad Barry.[(96057)]
